title: Dataset Import Formats
content: The demo platform accepts CSV, JSONL, and TSV files when importing datasets. Import formats describe how data enters the system, not how datasets are exported.

title: Report Export Options
content: Evaluation reports can be exported as CSV or JSON files. Report exports contain aggregate metrics, timestamps, and evaluation summaries rather than the original dataset export configuration.

title: Uploaded Dataset Retention
content: Uploaded temporary datasets are retained for 30 days by default. This retention policy applies to temporary uploaded files, not completed benchmark results.

title: Audit Log Retention
content: Administrative audit logs are retained for 90 days. Audit logs record workspace activity and are managed separately from benchmark evaluation results.

title: API Request Rate Limits
content: The demo API allows a maximum of 500 requests per hour for a standard workspace. This request rate limit is separate from the number of prompts allowed in an evaluation batch.

title: Prompt Template Length
content: Individual prompt templates may contain up to 500 characters. This limit controls the length of each template, not the number of prompts in an evaluation batch.

title: Knowledge Base Document Limit
content: A knowledge base can contain up to 500 documents in the standard workspace. This is a storage limit and does not specify the maximum number of prompts per evaluation batch.

title: API Key Rotation Policy
content: Workspace administrators should rotate API keys every 90 days and revoke keys that are no longer needed. This policy describes credential maintenance rather than where API keys are stored.

title: Token Usage Dashboard
content: The usage dashboard displays recorded input tokens, output tokens, and total token counts for each model request. It reports usage metrics but does not by itself calculate the final cost of an API request.

title: Model Pricing Reference
content: The model pricing reference lists configured input-token and output-token prices. Pricing values are used as configuration inputs for cost estimates and may change independently of recorded token usage.

title: Dataset Export Formats
content: The demo evaluation platform supports exporting datasets in CSV, JSONL, and Parquet formats.

title: Benchmark Result Retention
content: Benchmark results are retained for 90 days by default. A workspace owner may delete results sooner.

title: Evaluation Batch Limits
content: A single evaluation batch can contain a maximum of 500 prompts.

title: API Key Security
content: API keys must be stored on the server as environment variables. They must not be embedded in frontend code.

title: Model API Cost Estimation
content: Estimated model API costs are calculated using recorded input and output token usage and configured model pricing. The estimate is not a guaranteed billing total.
